sectorReasoning.reason: Connects customer concentration and shared construction demand to liquidity-constrained downside.

counterevidence.reason: Directly challenges customer dependence, termination, collection slippage and shared demand; notes company cash is not shareholder exit liquidity.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct funding, exposures, joint stress and independently correct smaller-allocation illustration.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Conditionally defends funded initial concentration with permanent-impairment acceptance and quantified smaller/abstention alternatives, preserving no later additions.

uncertainty.reason: No unsupported probability, maximum-loss claim or optimality; explicit downside acceptance is not alone proof of value.

missingEvidence: No current investment/market validation inferred; source inspection covers relevant selected pages rather than full issuer due diligence.
payload.independenceLimitation: Distinct actor IDs are provenance, not proof of independent humans or uncorrelated errors. Source answers and factual-error adjudication remain review responsibilities.
